title: BounceCoord
description: Landing spot of a pitch that hit the dirt before reaching the plate (spec §3.3). x: SAME normalized lateral axis as ZoneCoord.x (absolute, catcher's view; flip by handedness at render). depth: absolute FEET from the front edge of the plate; positive = toward the pitcher (bounced out front), 0 = front edge, negative = past the back edge (skipped). Absolute feet, not normalized, because ground geometry does not vary with batter height. Never clamp. Only ever an actual location, never a call (intendedLocation stays a ZoneCoord).
